subject: Mathematics

questions.prompt: Write one hundred and thirteen in numerals.
Write 89 in words.
steps: 8 tens are eighty; 9 ones are nine.

questions.prompt: Count the vertical lines shown; write the number in words.
steps: Count only the thin lines, not the cylinders.
The four groups have 3, 4, 3 and 3 lines: 3 + 4 + 3 + 3 = 13.

questions.prompt: Write the smallest of 56, 123, 98, 46, 44, 76, 87 in words.
steps: Compare hundreds, then tens, then ones.
44 is less than all the other values.

questions.prompt: How many circles are shown among the shapes?
steps: Count 3 circles in the top row and 4 in the bottom row.

questions.prompt: Write 60 + 500 + 3 in short form.
Fill the 5-by-5 number grid beginning 103, 104 and ending 127.
steps: Increase by 1 from left to right; continue on the next row.
Each next row begins 5 greater than the previous row.

questions.prompt: Write the four numbers immediately before 30.
steps: Write those values in ascending order.

questions.prompt: Write the three smallest of 353, 231, 346, 891, 945, 254.
Write the two numbers immediately after 75.
Calculate 567+23+126.
steps: Ones column: 7 + 3 + 6 = 16. Write 6. Carry 1 to the next column.
Tens column: 6 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 11. Write 1. Carry 1 to the next column.
Read the digits from left to right: 716.

questions.prompt: Find the missing addend: 846 + [ ] = 969.
Calculate 761-345.
steps: Ones column: 1 is too small to subtract 5. Regroup from the columns on its left to make 11.

questions.prompt: Calculate 998+21.
steps: Tens column: 9 + 2 = 11. Write 1. Carry 1 to the next column.
Hundreds column: 9 + 0 + 1 = 10. Write 0. Carry 1 to the next column.
Write the remaining carry, 1, on the left.
Read the digits from left to right: 1019.

questions.prompt: Calculate 885-234.
On which day did Kasemwa buy the most tomatoes?
steps: The greatest count is 5, shared by two days.

questions.prompt: Shade 2/4 of the circle divided into four equal parts.
steps: The denominator 4 is the total number of equal parts.
questions.answer: Shade any two quarters, making half the circle.

questions.prompt: Write hundreds, tens and ones digits from the grouped cylinders.
steps: Read 3 cylinders in the hundreds group, 4 in the tens group and 2 singles.

questions.prompt: How many triangles are shown?
steps: A triangle has three straight sides.
There are two triangles; ignore the two cylinders.

questions.prompt: Which figure A, B or C shows 2/4 shaded?
steps: Figure B is divided into four equal quarters.
Two of those quarters are shaded. A and C show halves but not four drawn parts.

questions.prompt: How many days are in a week?
steps: List Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

questions.prompt: A matchbox has 120 sticks. How many sticks are in two boxes?
Which pictured tool A or B measures volume using standard markings?
steps: B is a graduated measuring beaker, whose marks show volume.

questions.prompt: Find the total value of the two pictured Tanzanian 500-shilling coins.
Which day comes first in the listed week: Monday through Sunday?
steps: Read the given sequence from its beginning.

questions.prompt: Write 58 in words.
Write one hundred and thirteen in figures.
What is the place value of 4 in 45?
steps: The right digit is ones; the digit to its left is tens.
4 is in the tens column and has value 40.

questions.prompt: Write nine hundred and nine in figures.
steps: Keep zero in the tens place.

questions.prompt: Write 66 in words.
steps: 6 tens are sixty; 6 ones are six.
The missing positions are after 24, after 27 and after 29.

questions.prompt: Calculate 50 - 10 and write the answer in words.
What is the number immediately before 100?
Fill the three blanks between printed 90 and 95.
steps: There should be four intervening values, but the source draws only three blanks.
questions.answer: Source error: four blanks are required for 91, 92, 93, 94. If filling the three shown from left, use 91, 92, 93; 94 is missing.

questions.prompt: Find the greatest of 78, 90, 56, 73, 89, 81, 65, 52.
steps: 90 has 9 tens, more than all the others.

questions.prompt: Calculate 462+126.
steps: Read the digits from left to right: 588.

questions.prompt: Calculate 83-52.
Calculate 57+23+13.
steps: Ones column: 7 + 3 + 3 = 13. Write 3. Carry 1 to the next column.
Read the digits from left to right: 93.

questions.prompt: Calculate 132+257.
steps: Read the digits from left to right: 389.

questions.prompt: Calculate 69-12.
Name the line through X and Y, with arrows at both ends.
steps: Arrows at both ends mean it continues in both directions.

questions.prompt: How many triangles are shown beside the circle?
steps: Count the shapes with three straight sides.
There is one triangle on each side of the circle.

questions.prompt: Name the four-sided figure shown.
steps: It has four right angles and opposite equal sides.
Its length is greater than its width.

questions.prompt: What is the name of a round plane figure?
steps: The boundary is one continuous curve.

questions.prompt: Name the pointed five-point figure shown.
steps: The familiar name is a star.

questions.prompt: How many toes does a person normally have?
steps: There are five toes on each foot.

questions.prompt: A class has 10 boys and 15 girls. How many pupils are there?
Mama Kishoka has 56 apples and gives her son 5. How many remain?
What fraction of the four-part circle is shaded?
steps: Exactly 1 quarter is shaded, so shaded/total = 1/4.

questions.prompt: How many hands do five pupils have?
